source: Wisconsin DNR Hunting Regulations, Fall 2026-Spring 2027 (Open Water Restrictions; Management Zones and Units); Wisconsin DNR Managed Lands (DNR Owned property, public access); USGS NHD; OpenStreetMap (BNSF).

areas.n: Mississippi River goose subzone
areas.d: Goose zone, not a duck zone: the Mississippi River Zone is the part of Wisconsin west of the BNSF railroad tracks to the state line, from Grant County north to Pierce County. Canada geese Oct 3-11 and Oct 17 - Jan 5, 2027, 3 a day (the Southern zone season is Sept 16 - Oct 11, Oct 17 - Dec 6, Dec 19 - Jan 2; the Northern zone Sept 16 - Dec 16). Ducks follow the Northern or Southern zone as usual. APPROXIMATE: the tracks are the OpenStreetMap BNSF main line (St. Croix and Aurora subdivisions); the DNR map is a picture and no GIS layer was found.

areas.n: Lake Winnebago - open-water blind restrictions
areas.d: Open-water rule (Fall 2026-Spring 2027 regulations): it is illegal to hunt waterfowl in open water from or with the aid of any blind, boat, canoe or raft unless it is at least 500 ft from shore, anchored, and removed daily; you may hunt within 3 ft of shore or of rooted vegetation that hides you, or standing on the bottom without a blind. Outline: USGS NHD lake.

areas.n: Lake Pepin - open-water blind rule
areas.d: Open-water rule (Fall 2026-Spring 2027 regulations): on Lake Pepin and the Grant County portions of the Mississippi River there is no minimum distance from shore, but blinds must be anchored and removed daily. Elsewhere on the Mississippi River a blind may be at most 100 ft from shore, anchored, and removed daily. Outline: USGS NHD lake (the Wisconsin part of the lake outline).
